title: UI风格#7 - Retro Terminal (复古终端)
description: 创建第7种UI风格：复古终端风格 - 绿屏CRT、 phosphor光晕、80年代终端感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planG.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When color palette Then features classic green-on-black (#00FF00 on #0D0D0D), amber (#FFB000) as secondary
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #0D0D0D CRT black, #00FF41 phosphor green, #003B00 dark green, #FFB000 amber, #FF0040 error red

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When typography Then uses monospace fonts: VT323, Space Mono, or IBM Plex Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: VT323 (display headers), Fira Code (monospace body)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When layout Then terminal window with title bar, scanlines, CRT curvature effect
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: scanline overlay via repeating-linear-gradient, vignette via radial-gradient, phosphor glow via text-shadow stacking, terminal chrome with title bar

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal style When UI elements Then text glow effect, blinking cursor, command prompt style input
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: text-shadow glow, blinking cursor animation (500ms), command prompt input with > prefix, terminal-style buttons

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal UI When functional Then includes terminal-style chat, ASCII art, command output display
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: terminal chat with > prompts, ASCII art header, process list for agents, system monitor, command menu

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Terminal UI When copy Then uses hacker/terminal language: 'Executing', 'Initializing', 'Connection established', 'root@system#'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'root@symbiosis:~$', status '> INITIALIZING...', '> CONNECTION ESTABLISHED', buttons EXECUTE/TRANSMIT/ABORT/REBOOT
